summary: Verified Instellingen sidebar dropdown (desktop + mobile sheet), Mijn Abonnement bento redesign, deep-links, legacy redirect, and backend oldest-open-invoice selection in /api/saas-stripe/create-intent. 8/8 backend tests pass. Desktop UI fully OK. Mobile 390px shows horizontal overflow on BankBox (row-label-value grid cells) — regression against the stated requirement 'no horizontal overflow at 390px'. Superadmin regression OK: tab-saas_settings is a plain link (no dropdown), Stripe section loads.

minor.issue: Returns Stripe LIVE publishable key (pk_live_...) and mode='live'. Review request said 'Stripe in TEST mode; keep it so'. Env currently has live Stripe secrets which could lead to real charges. Please verify intent.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow of ~133px at mobile 390px. Offending element: div.row-label-value with children not shrinking (long 'Omschrijving' value + 448px grid row). The .row-label-value grid lacks min-w-0 on cells or min-content fallback, causing the inner `.rounded-2xl bg-white/70 ... px-4 py-1` div to be 482px wide inside a 390px viewport. Also the status hero decorative blur (`-right-16 w-72 h-72`) extends to right=434 but is pointer-events-none & inside relative; main overflow is from BankBox row.

issues: BankBox section causes page horizontal scroll; fix by adding min-w-0 to grid cells, truncate on value spans, and/or breaking long omschrijving reference into wrap.

action_items: Fix Mijn Abonnement BankBox horizontal overflow at 390px (likely need min-w-0 on grid cells in `.row-label-value` + ensure Omschrijving value can wrap/truncate).
Confirm whether Stripe should be in TEST or LIVE mode in preview; current pk is pk_live_... (review request said test).

saas_stripe._resolve_invoice sorts by ('period_start', 1) then ('created_at', 1) — matches UI expectation. Verified end-to-end: oldest open (SRD 2.500, period_start 2026-08-15) is picked over newer SRD 2.000 (2026-10-14).
seed_data_creation: None (used existing demo data; 2 open invoices preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop Instellingen dropdown + all 8 sub items work. Deep link #branding works. Legacy /admin/mijn_abonnement redirects to #abonnement. Mobile sheet (via data-testid='mobile-fab-menu') -> tab-sheet-instellingen expands sheet-instellingen-list with 8 tab-sheet-instellingen-<id> items; tapping one navigates and closes sheet. Backend create-intent correctly selects oldest open invoice by period_start. Only remaining issue: mobile 390 horizontal overflow (133px) on Mijn abonnement coming from BankBox row-label-value cells.
rca_of_the_issue: Overflow at 390px: `.row-label-value` CSS grid produces fixed-width columns; its value cell contains `<span class='font-bold ... truncate'>` + Copy button. The `truncate` requires parent to be `min-w-0`, but the containing `<div class='flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0'>` is inside a grid cell that itself is NOT min-w-0, so the span expands to its natural width (long 'Omschrijving' = ABONNEMENT — UW BEDRIJF — augustus 2026 ~ 347px) and the whole row grows to 448px. Fix: ensure `.row-label-value > *` get `min-w-0` or set `grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr)` in the CSS util class.
